query: What conditions must I meet in order to receive and retain the matching grant?
reference_answer: To receive and retain the matching grant, you must:be eligible for the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme for the year;have received cash top-ups during the year; andstill be a Singapore Citizen when the matching grant is credited to your Retirement Account (RA) at the beginning of the following year.Do note that cash top-ups are irreversible. Read more about theirreversibilitycondition.In an unlikely event where the cash top-up is reversed and you had already received the matching grant, the grant and any interest earned on it will be recovered from your CPF account.

answer: To receive and retain the matching grant, you must be eligible for the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme, have received cash top-ups during the year, and be a Singapore Citizen when the grant is credited. Additionally, cash top-ups must be made by 31 December in the year of eligibility and cannot be reversed. [Document 1]
